acceptance: go/internal/phases/ship imports the incident store through a leaf package and no longer imports go/internal/selfheal
The count of internal packages in the import closure of go/internal/phases/ship returns to its value before commit 8d81305f1
An import guard test fails when phases/ship imports selfheal again
fix: Move the incident store (the Incident and Observation types, DetectLive, UpdateIncidents, LoadIncidents, Dir) and StopBound to a leaf package that imports no detector. Keep selfheal as a consumer of that package. Do the design review first.
summary: The ship phase calls selfheal.StopBound (ADR-0165 G4b step 6, PR #1395). The import brings the full import fan of selfheal into phases/ship: 167 to 179 internal packages. The ship phase needs only the incident store and the bound check.
title: A leaf package holds the incident store, so the ship phase does not import selfheal
